title: The Midnight Wedding
text: A contract surfaces, signed by your House three generations ago: one of its children to be wed, at midnight, to a groom from beyond the Gate. The groom has arrived. He is very tall, and he waits in the courtyard without moving.

outcomes.text: The vows are spoken in a language none of you know. The Scion returns at dawn with a ring of black iron and a stranger's patience.
The vows are spoken. The Scion returns at dawn, and in the night they talk in their sleep in his voice.

options.label: Dress a recruit in the bridal veil.

outcomes.text: He takes the recruit's hand without looking under the veil. They are not seen again.
He lifts the veil, looks for a long time, and leaves. The courtyard stones are frozen where he stood.

options.label: Tear the contract up in front of him.

outcomes.text: He bows, very low, and goes back the way he came. The House's name is a little lighter in old mouths.
He goes. The next morning every mirror in the Seat is cracked.
